injuries.name: Seth Jarvis
injuries.note: Jarvis was initially pegged to miss about 4-6 months after having shoulder surgery in June. However, he believes he could return ahead of schedule after taking to the ice during training camp. Jarvis amassed 32 goals, 66 points, 224 shots on net and 81 hits in 71 games for the Hurricanes during the 2025-26 regular season.

injuries.name: Connor Bedard
injuries.note: Bedard has a doctor's visit scheduled for this coming week to determine when he can return to the lineup. It's unclear if he will be ready to play as early as Tuesday's matchup against Pittsburgh, but the 21-year-old forward appears to be inching toward his 2026-27 debut. Bedard notched 30 goals and 75 points in 69 regular-season games for the Blackhawks in 2025-26.
